verdict.rationale: Snyk ships an official, well-documented CLI (github.com/snyk/cli, docs.snyk.io/developer-tools/snyk-cli) usable locally, in IDEs, and in CI/CD, and it now includes explicit AI-native/agentic capabilities: `snyk fix --agentic` for interactive human-in-the-loop remediation, `snyk code test`, and support for a local MCP server plus slash commands (`/snyk-fix`, `/snyk-batch-fix`) for coding assistants. This directly satisfies the ask of an official CLI usable in agentic/AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the agentic CLI features (community evidence found covers general Snyk PR/dependency tooling complaints, not the CLI's AI-native flows).
